page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.small is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the shared ecs.s6 family, provisioned via the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and provides 1 shared vCPU from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It includes 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio.

The hardware configuration contains no local storage, requiring all operating system and persistent data needs to be fulfilled by external cloud block storage. There are no GPU accelerators present, and the instance defaults to a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned.

Because the vCPU is provisioned using a shared allocation model, CPU compute cycles are subject to host-level multi-tenant sharing. This design delivers a cost-efficient resource profile for low-utilization scenarios, though it involves tradeoffs in processing determinism and sustained compute throughput compared to instances with dedicated cores.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.small is suitable for lightweight development environments, small-scale testing, low-traffic web serving, background administrative tasks, and microservices that do not require dedicated CPU time or intensive local disk I/O.
